hooks.command: if [ -f vendor/bin/phpstan ]; then vendor/bin/phpstan analyse --no-progress --memory-limit=512M 2>&1 | tail -20; fi

set -e

echo 'Running Pint (formatting)...'
if [ -f vendor/bin/pint ]; then
  vendor/bin/pint --dirty
fi

# Prevent silent formatting changes from slipping into commit
if ! git diff --quiet; then
  echo 'Code was reformatted by Pint. Please review and re-commit.'
  exit 1
fi

echo 'Running PHPStan...'
if [ -f vendor/bin/phpstan ]; then
  vendor/bin/phpstan analyse --no-progress --memory-limit=512M
fi

echo 'Running tests...'
if [ -f vendor/bin/pest ]; then
  vendor/bin/pest --no-coverage
elif [ -f vendor/bin/phpunit ]; then
  vendor/bin/phpunit
fi

echo 'All checks passed. Proceeding with commit.'
